script.text: After Aster defeated Jaden, Sartorius traveled to Duel Academy in order to assess the school's students.
While on the island, Sartorius came across Chazz Princeton.
I am known as Sartorius. I’ve traveled quite a ways to meet you.
Yeah? And why’d ya wanna meet me?
Simple. I could use someone like you.
Tell you what, I have an idea. Why don't you show me what you've got? Perhaps I'll sign you on as my client.
I manage professional duelists. Ever hear of Aster Pheonix?
You manage him?!
Indeed. Now let’s see if you’re ready for the pros.

Chazz was defeated, and Sartorius took over Chazz's mind using the magical powers of the mysterious Light of Destruction. Sartorius also forced Chazz to join the sinister Society of Light organization.
Later on, Dr. Crowler was shocked to learn that Chancellor Sheppard had returned to announce a new tournament.
Thanks for keeping my seat warm while I've been away, Crowler. But now I'm back, and there's important business to discuss.
What can I do to assist you, sir?
Gather all the students. I have an important announcement to make and it affects everyone! It’s going to change our lives!
The newly-returned Chancellor Sheppard addressed the entire student body.
First of all, it's good to be back! I have a special gift to offer all of you!
A gift? Man, it's good to have Sheppard back!
I give you the GX Dueling Tournament! A competition for the next generation of master duelists! It’s like nothing you’ve ever experienced before!
And it starts right now!
Duelists from around the globe will converge here! Students and professionals are welcome!
When the dust settles and only one duelist remains, he will be known as The World's Greatest!
That's me! I'll beat all the pros!

Chazz took advantage of the tournament in order to challenge Jaden to a rematch. However, Jaden was late to their duel because he was busy searching for Chazz's old jacket – his most favorite thing in the world. Jaden hoped to use the jacket to break Chazz's mind control.
What’s your problem!? Did you forget or just chicken out!?
Actually, I was going through your old stuff and lost track of time. I found your old jacket and thought you might like to try it on again.
Put that away! I know what you’re trying to do and it won’t work! I won't go back to the way I was!
The old Chazz doesn’t exist anymore! I’ve seen the light!
But if that’s true, then why does part of me want to wear that jacket?
If you change your mind, I'll leave it right here for ya, Chazz.
Fine! I'll use it to wipe the mess once I beat you! Let's duel!
